title: Flight plan timeline, elapsed time 3:00–4:30: egress/ingress, separation from booster
description: Vertical elapsed-time axis from 3:00 to 4:30 listing activities such as "EGRESS S/C", "INGRESS S/C CLOSE HATCH REPRESSURIZE S/C", "SEPARATION ΔV ~5 FT/SEC", "COMPLETE INGRESS CHECKLIST" and medical data tape playbacks. Boxed tracking-station codes (TEX, GYM, CNV, ANT, ASC, PRE, TAN, CRO, HAW) and a hatched "NIGHT" bar appear on the right. A handwritten "c.e.t." note is at top left.
